issues.summary: Four g_board_diversity rows have an incomplete or wrong quantitative evidence chain.
evidence: 002011 has value 2 but cites only a greater-than-20-percent statement; canonical p8:b9 directly states female=2.
603918 has value 1 but cites only professional diversity; canonical p38:b1 directly states female directors=1.
603990 has value 1 but its cited block stops before the count; canonical p47:b1 directly states female=1.
02651 returns total board size 7 although the same canonical sentence states three female directors.
issues.required_fix: Apply auditable deterministic corrections from canonical blocks, preserve before/after provenance, strengthen validation, and rebuild all hashes and downstream statistics.

issues.summary: A completed upload redirects to formal_current, so its task result appears as a misleading zero-issue formal report.

issues.summary: Upload registration writes into frozen source ledgers even though the PDF remains in the isolated task directory.
